[[File:Lylek_RS11BT3.png|thumb|right|250px|A seemingly deadly battle with a [[Lylek/Legends|lylek]] done in virtual reality]]
'''Virtual reality''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] realm accessed by such devices as [[Mind evaporator/Legends|mind evaporators]]. [[Mermeia]] existed within virtual reality.

The [[Nubian Palace]] contained a virtual reality suite,<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> and the [[Otherworld Encounter]] allowed customers to simulate walking around the surface of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] inner core.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> The [[Sym-voyage]] took this to a higher level, allowing patrons to "visit" exotic [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] without leaving their homeworld.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref> The ''[[Star of Empire]]'' library also provided virtual reality services such as games and tutorials; [[Jan Ors]] had a virtual dancing performance.<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>
